newsitem.title: USA: Healthsource to redeem purchase rights.
newsitem.headline: Healthsource to redeem purchase rights.

text.p: Healthsource Inc said on Friday that it will redeem all of the outstanding common stock purchase rights issued after a rights agreement dated as of July 29, 1996.

The agreement, between Heathsource and the Bank of New York, calls for a redemption price of $.001 per right in cash. The rights will be redeemed in connection with the consummation of a tender offer by CHC Acquisition Corp, a subsidiary of CIGNA Corp, to purchase all of the issued and outstanding shares of Healthsource's common stock, Healthsource said.
The tender offer is currently scheduled to expire at midnight, New York City time, on June 20.
Healthsource, a managed healthcare service provider, also said it would hold a shareholders meeting on July 28 to ask investors to approve the merger of CHC with Healthsource.
